paper_title: Effects of Alkyl Side Chains Positioning and Presence of Fused Aromatic Units in the Backbone of Low-Bandgap Diketopyrrolopyrrole Copolymers on the Optoelectronic Properties of Organic Solar Cells
source_file: /home/wzfeng/MySearch/PhotoRag/MD/Journal of Polymer Science Part A  Polymer Chemistry - 2017 - Chochos - Effects of alkyl side chains positioning and/auto/Journal of Polymer Science Part A  Polymer Chemistry - 2017 - Chochos - Effects of alkyl side chains positioning and.md

knowledge_points.content: The study compares tail-to-tail (TT or α-position) and head-to-head (HH or β-position) anchoring of linear dodecyl side chains on the outer thiophene units of quaterthiophene-based DPP copolymers.
knowledge_points.evidence: In particular, we investigate alkyl side chain positioning by introducing linear alkyl side chains into two different positions (α- and β-), and the distance of the electron rich and electron deficient monomers... namely tail-to-tail (TT) and head-to-head (HH).

knowledge_points.content: Low-bandgap DPP copolymers were synthesized via Stille aromatic cross-coupling polymerization using Pd2(dba)3 as the catalyst and P(o-tol)3 as the ligand in toluene.
knowledge_points.evidence: The copolymers were synthesized by Stille aromatic cross-coupling polymerization utilizing tris(dibenzylideneacetone)dipalladium(0) [Pd2(dba)3] in 2% per mole and tri(o-tolyl)phosphine [P(o-tol)3] 8% per mole, as the catalytic system in toluene solution.

knowledge_points.content: The reference polymer DPP4T (unsubstituted quaterthiophene-DPP) achieved an optimal power conversion efficiency (PCE) of 4.0% with a short-circuit current (Jsc) of 9.2 mA/cm² and an open-circuit voltage (Voc) of 0.66 V.

Head-to-head (HH) positioning of side chains in DPP copolymers (DPP4Tb and DPP2TT2Tb) leads to an increase in open-circuit voltage (Voc) by approximately 0.1 V compared to tail-to-tail (TT) positioning (DPP4Ta and DPP2TT2Ta).
knowledge_points.evidence: In the case of the HH conformation (DPP4Tb or DPP2TT2Tb), the respective solar cells exhibit almost 0.1 eV enhanced Voc versus solar cells comprising DPP4Ta or DPP2TT2Ta (TT conformation).

knowledge_points.content: The tail-to-tail (TT) conformation of alkyl side chains results in higher short-circuit currents (Jsc) compared to the head-to-head (HH) conformation due to minimized steric hindrance along the polymer backbone.
knowledge_points.evidence: In addition, if the alkyl side chains are anchored as TT conformation, the photocurrents are improved... minimization of steric hindrance is estimated when the didodecyl side chains are in the TT conformation.

knowledge_points.content: DFT calculations show that the dihedral angle (θ4) between adjacent units is significantly higher in head-to-head (HH) polymers (58.5° for DPP4Tb) compared to tail-to-tail (TT) polymers (17.3° for DPP4Ta).
knowledge_points.evidence: In particular, the most important alteration is detected on θ4 dihedral angle where the rotation between the adjacent units in DPP4Tb is 58.5° as compared with 17.3° in DPP4Ta.

knowledge_points.content: Introducing alkyl side chains significantly improves the processability of DPP copolymers, allowing them to be dissolved at 40 °C compared to 75 °C required for the unsubstituted DPP4T derivative.
knowledge_points.evidence: The beneficial role of the alkyl side chains positioning of the processability is highlighted in the fact that DPP4Ta, DPP4Tb, DPP2TT2Ta and DPP2TT2Tb were dissolved at much lower temperature (40 °C) than DPP4T (75 °C).

knowledge_points.content: Replacing thiophene rings with fused thieno[3,2-b]thiophene units in the DPP copolymer backbone enhances the short-circuit current (Jsc) and overall PCE, despite slightly higher optical bandgaps.
knowledge_points.evidence: both DPP2TT2Ta and DPP2TT2Tb exhibit enhanced Jsc and hence increased PCEs versus DPP4Ta and DPP4Tb even though they have slightly higher optical bandgaps.

knowledge_points.content: The ionization potentials (IP) of the polymers were determined using Photo-Electron Spectroscopy in Air (PESA), ranging from 5.13 eV (DPP2TT2Ta) to 5.24 eV (DPP4T).
knowledge_points.evidence: The ionization potentials (IPs) of all DPP-based copolymers were determined by PESA... The IPs of DPP4T, DPP4Ta, DPP4Tb, DPP2TT2Ta, and DPP2TT2Tb are 5.24, 5.14, 5.21, 5.13, and 5.23 eV, respectively.

knowledge_points.content: The organic solar cells were fabricated using an inverted architecture: ITO/PFN/active layer/MoO3/Al, where PFN acts as the electron transport layer.
knowledge_points.evidence: investigated organic solar cells with an inverted ITO/PFN/active layer/MoO3/Al device architecture... a poly[(9,9-bis(3'-(N,N-dimethylamino)propyl)-2,7-fluorene)-alt-2,7-(9,9-dioctylfluorene)] (PFN) solution... was spun onto the ITO substrate.

knowledge_points.content: The active layer blend (polymer:PC71BM ratio 1:3) optimization included the addition of 2% 1,8-diiodooctane (DIO) as a solvent additive and thermal annealing at 85 °C for 5 minutes.
knowledge_points.evidence: polymer:fullerene ratios of 1:3. Three hours before the photoactive layer deposition, 2% of 1,8-diiodooctane were added to the blend solution... thermally annealed (at ambient pressure) at 85 °C for 5 min.

knowledge_points.content: Atomic Force Microscopy (AFM) analysis showed that the DPP2TT2Tb:PC71BM blend had a smoother film and less phase contrast, suggesting excessive component intermixing and leading to a low fill factor (FF) of 42.4%.
knowledge_points.evidence: For the DPP2TT2Tb:PC71BM we observe an even smoother film and less contrast in the phase image, which may hint to more intermixing of the components... in line with the observed low FF.
